---
title: "__HOST__"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

A blank interactive document: R Markdown whose output reacts. Prose and
code as in any report, with Shiny inputs and outputs inside it. A save
shows on the next load of the page.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
sliderInput("n", "Points", min = 10, max = 1000, value = 200, step = 10)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({
  set.seed(1)
  hist(rnorm(input$n), breaks = 30, main = paste(input$n, "draws from a normal distribution"), xlab = "x")
}, height = 300)
```
